headword: {口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}

definitions.explanation: A reputation formed through personal recommendations, online reviews, and informal evaluations passed between people. Extremely common in modern Japanese consumer culture, especially for restaurants, products, and services.

examples.japanese: {口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧。
examples.english: A shop with good word-of-mouth reviews.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧にして⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose it based on the online reviews.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れて→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧しまった。
examples.english: This product had very high word-of-mouth ratings and sold out quickly.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{口|くち}コミ→口コミ：17690_kuchikomi⟧ (word of mouth; reviews) + ⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧ (reputation; reviews). ⟦{口|くち}コミ→口コミ：17690_kuchikomi⟧ itself is a blend of ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth) + ⟦コミュニケーション→コミュニケーション：08425_komyunikeeshon⟧ (communication), though it is now a standalone word. In modern usage, ⟦{口|くち}コミ→口コミ：17690_kuchikomi⟧ often refers to online reviews as much as spoken recommendations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧: to have good reviews
- {口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to check the reviews
- {口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まる→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧: to spread through word of mouth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口|くち}コミ→口コミ：17690_kuchikomi⟧: word of mouth; reviews — the base term, used alone more often in casual speech
- ⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧: reputation; fame — the general concept of public opinion about something
- ⟦レビュー→レビュー：11193_rebyuu⟧: review — the loanword, used especially for online product and service reviews
